assessments.reasoning: The exact W3C Recommendation URI and heading identify XPath 3.1 and the 21 March 2017 publication. The independently downloaded full response SHA-256 matches the registered source revision. The definition associates array members with positive integer positions and specifies position 1 for the first. The indexing domain is positions over members. A member may be an entire sequence under the square constructor. The record scopes the first-member rule to a nonempty array and the exact XPath 3.1 Recommendation. The empty array has no first member. A member that is an empty sequence still occupies a position if it was added as a member.

limitations: An array member can be a sequence. Positions count members, not their contained items.
